say:0:1122208001:0.text: That guy's info doesn't match what Cyril told us at all.
say:0:1122208001:0.source_cn: 这个人说的盗匪逃跑的方向，和西里尔大叔告诉我们的完全不一样。

say:1:1122208002:0.text: And his story was all over the place.
say:1:1122208002:0.source_cn: 而且，他说话不仅结结巴巴的，还前后矛盾。

say:2:1122208003:0.text: Chippy thinks that guy was a total scammer! Let's follow Cyril's word!
say:2:1122208003:0.source_cn: 他肯定是在骗人！满满觉得，还是西里尔更可靠！

say:3:1122208004:0.text: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
say:3:1122208004:0.source_cn: 别着急，我们再去和镇郊旅店的商人聊聊。
say:3:1122208004:0.male: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
say:3:1122208004:0.female: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
